title: OEIS WASM Evaluator PyO3 FFI Contract
description: Interface contract for the native Rust PyO3 batch WASM execution module (oeis_wasm_evaluator)

consumed_fuel.description: Total instruction fuel consumed during evaluation

functions.name: evaluate_wat_batch
functions.description: Evaluates a batch of WAT program strings concurrently across CPU worker threads using Rayon, releasing the Python GIL.

wat_programs.description: List of WebAssembly Text format program strings

fuel_budget.description: Instruction fuel limit per program instance

terms_to_generate.description: Number of sequence terms to evaluate (n = 0..terms_to_generate - 1)

functions.name: evaluate_wat_single
functions.description: Evaluates a single WAT program string in-memory with exact fuel metering and linear memory limits.
